raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":1588,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.refund_amount > 0 THEN o.order_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS refund_rate FROM ecommerce.orders o LEFT JOIN ecommerce.order_item oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计整体退款率","tables":["MYSQL:ecommerce.orders","MYSQL:ecommerce.order_item"],"columns":["order_id","refund_amount"]}],"assumptions":[]}
